File: app/Models/WisataModel.php Bagian III • PHP • 51 baris 
 1<?php
 2
 3namespace App\Models;
 4
 5use CodeIgniter\Model;
 6
 7class WisataModel extends Model
 8{
 9    protected $table            = 'wisata';
10    protected $primaryKey       = 'id';
11    protected $useAutoIncrement = true;
12    protected $returnType       = 'array';
13    protected $useSoftDeletes   = false;
14    protected $allowedFields    = [
15        'kategori_id', 'nama', 'deskripsi', 'alamat', 'telepon',
16        'lat', 'lng', 'harga_tiket', 'jam_buka', 'jam_tutup',
17        'rating', 'foto', 'status_aktif', 'status_operasional', 'catatan_status'
18    ];
19    protected $useTimestamps    = true;
20    protected $createdField     = 'created_at';
21    protected $updatedField     = 'updated_at';
22
23    /**
24     * Ambil data wisata dengan join ke tabel kategori.
25     */
26    public function getAllWithKategori(bool $onlyActive = true): array
27    {
28        $builder = $this->db->table('wisata')
29            ->select('wisata.*, kategori.nama AS kategori_nama')
30            ->join('kategori', 'kategori.id = wisata.kategori_id', 'left');
31
32        if ($onlyActive) {
33            $builder->where('wisata.status_aktif', 1);
34        }
35
36        return $builder->orderBy('wisata.rating', 'DESC')->get()->getResultArray();
37    }
38
39    /**
40     * Eksekusi SQL terparameterisasi yang dikompilasi secara deterministik oleh SpatialQueryCompiler.
41     *
42     * @param string $sql
43     * @param array $params
44     * @return array
45     */
46    public function executeCompiledSpatialQuery(string $sql, array $params): array
47    {
48        $query = $this->db->query($sql, $params);
49        return $query->getResultArray();
50    }
51}

 1<?php
 2
 3namespace App\Models;
 4
 5use CodeIgniter\Model;
 6
 7class ChatSessionModel extends Model
 8{
 9    protected $table            = 'chat_sessions';
10    protected $primaryKey       = 'id';
11    protected $useAutoIncrement = true;
12    protected $returnType       = 'array';
13    protected $allowedFields    = ['session_token', 'lat', 'lng'];
14    protected $useTimestamps    = true;
15    protected $createdField     = 'created_at';
16    protected $updatedField     = 'updated_at';
17
18    public function getOrCreateSession(string $token, ?float $lat = null, ?float $lng = null): array
19    {
20        $session = $this->where('session_token', $token)->first();
21        if ($session) {
22            if ($lat !== null && $lng !== null) {
23                $this->update($session['id'], [
24                    'lat' => $lat,
25                    'lng' => $lng,
26                    'updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
27                ]);
28                $session['lat'] = $lat;
29                $session['lng'] = $lng;
30            }
31            return $session;
32        }
33
34        $id = $this->insert([
35            'session_token' => $token,
36            'lat'           => $lat,
37            'lng'           => $lng,
38            'created_at'    => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
39            'updated_at'    => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
40        ]);
41
42        return $this->find($id);
43    }
44}

 3namespace App\Models;

 5use CodeIgniter\Model;
 6
 7class ChatMessageModel extends Model
 8{
 9    protected $table            = 'chat_messages';
10    protected $primaryKey       = 'id';
11    protected $useAutoIncrement = true;
12    protected $returnType       = 'array';
13    protected $allowedFields    = ['session_id', 'role', 'pesan', 'intent_json'];
14    protected $useTimestamps    = true;
15    protected $createdField     = 'created_at';
16    protected $updatedField     = 'updated_at';
17
18    public function getHistory(int $sessionId, int $limit = 20): array
19    {
20        return $this->where('session_id', $sessionId)
21            ->orderBy('id', 'ASC')
22            ->limit($limit)
23            ->findAll();
24    }
25}

 792    <!-- Leaflet JS -->
 793    <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" integrity="sha256-20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=" crossorigin=""></script>
 794    <script>
 795        // Inisialisasi Data & Titik Pusat Padang
 796        const PADANG_CENTER = [-0.9471, 100.4174];
 797        let map;
 798        let markersLayer;
 799        let routeLayer;
 800        let userMarker;
 801        let userCoords = null;
 802        let sessionToken = localStorage.getItem('geo_session_token') || '';
 803
 804        // Master Data POI dari Server
 805        const allPlaces = <?= json_encode($wisataList, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?>;
 806
 807        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
 808            initMap();
 809            plotPlaces(allPlaces);
 810            setupCategoryFilters();
 811            autoDetectGps();
 812        });
 813
 814        function initMap() {
 815            map = L.map('map', {
 816                center: PADANG_CENTER,
 817                zoom: 13,
 818                zoomControl: false
 819            });
 820
 821            // Modern Dark/Clean Map Tile OpenStreetMap
 822            L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
 823                attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors',
 824                maxZoom: 19
 825            }).addTo(map);
 826
 827            L.control.zoom({ position: 'bottomleft' }).addTo(map);
 828
 829            markersLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
 830            routeLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
 831        }
 832
 833        function getMarkerCategoryClass(kategori) {
 834            const k = (kategori || '').toLowerCase();
 835            if (k.includes('pantai')) return 'marker-pantai';
 836            if (k.includes('pulau')) return 'marker-pulau';
 837            if (k.includes('alam')) return 'marker-alam';
 838            if (k.includes('museum')) return 'marker-museum';
 839            if (k.includes('sejarah')) return 'marker-sejarah';
 840            if (k.includes('kuliner')) return 'marker-kuliner';
 841            return 'marker-alam';
 842        }
 843
 844        function getCategoryIcon(kategori) {
 845            const k = (kategori || '').toLowerCase();
 846            if (k.includes('pantai')) return '🏖️';
 847            if (k.includes('pulau')) return '🏝️';
 848            if (k.includes('alam')) return '🌿';
 849            if (k.includes('museum')) return '🏛️';
 850            if (k.includes('sejarah')) return '🏰';
 851            if (k.includes('kuliner')) return '🍲';
 852            return '📍';
 853        }
 854
 855        function plotPlaces(places) {
 856            markersLayer.clearLayers();
 857
 858            places.forEach(p => {
 859                const lat = parseFloat(p.lat);
 860                const lng = parseFloat(p.lng);
 861                const catClass = getMarkerCategoryClass(p.kategori_nama || p.kategori);
 862                const iconEmoji = getCategoryIcon(p.kategori_nama || p.kategori);
 863
 864                const icon = L.divIcon({
 865                    className: 'custom-div-icon',
 866                    html: `<div class="custom-poi-marker ${catClass}" data-id="${p.id}">${iconEmoji}</div>`,
 867                    iconSize: [36, 36],
 868                    iconAnchor: [18, 18],
 869                    popupAnchor: [0, -18]
 870                });
 871
 872                const tiket = p.harga_tiket == 0 ? 'Gratis' : 'Rp' + parseInt(p.harga_tiket).toLocaleString('id-ID');
 873                const jam = (p.jam_buka && p.jam_tutup) ? (p.jam_buka.substring(0, 5) + ' - ' + p.jam_tutup.substring(0, 5) + ' WIB') : 'Buka 24 Jam';
 874
 875                const popupHtml = `
 876                    <div style="min-width: 220px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;">
 877                        <img src="${p.foto}" style="width: 100%; height: 90px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
 878                        <span style="font-size: 0.65rem; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(6,182,212,0.2); color:#22d3ee; font-weight:600;">
 879                            ${p.kategori_nama || p.kategori || 'Wisata'}
 880                        </span>
 881                        <h4 style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 4px 0 6px;">${p.nama}</h4>
 882                        <p style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 8px;">${p.deskripsi || ''}</p>
 883                        <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #cbd5e1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
 884                            <div>🎫 <strong>Tiket:</strong> ${tiket}</div>
 885                            <div>⏰ <strong>Jam:</strong> ${jam}</div>
 886                            <div>📍 <strong>Alamat:</strong> ${p.alamat || '-'}</div>
 887                        </div>
 888                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px;">
 889                            <button onclick="askAboutPlace('${p.nama}')" style="flex:1; padding: 6px; font-size: 0.72rem; background: var(--primary); color: #04131d; font-weight:600; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer;">
 890                                Tanya AI
 891                            </button>
 892                            <button onclick="calculateRoute(${lat}, ${lng}, '${p.nama}')" style="flex:1; padding: 6px; font-size: 0.72rem; background: rgba(59,130,246,0.3); color: #93c5fd; font-weight:600; border:1px solid #3b82f6; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer;">
 893                                Rute OSRM
 894                            </button>
 895                        </div>
 896                    </div>
 897                `;
 898
 899                const marker = L.marker([lat, lng], { icon: icon }).bindPopup(popupHtml);
 900                marker.poiId = p.id;
 901                markersLayer.addLayer(marker);
 902            });
 903        }
 904
 905        function setupCategoryFilters() {
 906            document.querySelectorAll('.cat-chip').forEach(btn => {
 907                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
 908                    document.querySelectorAll('.cat-chip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
 909                    btn.classList.add('active');
 910
 911                    const selected = btn.getAttribute('data-category');
 912                    if (selected === 'Semua') {
 913                        plotPlaces(allPlaces);
 914                        resetToCenter();
 915                    } else {
 916                        const filtered = allPlaces.filter(p => (p.kategori_nama || p.kategori) === selected);
 917                        plotPlaces(filtered);
 918                        if (filtered.length > 0) {
 919                            const group = L.featureGroup(markersLayer.getLayers());
 920                            map.fitBounds(group.getBounds().pad(0.2));
 921                        }
 922                    }
 923                });
 924            });
 925        }
 926
 927        function resetToCenter() {
 928            map.flyTo(PADANG_CENTER, 13, { duration: 1.2 });
 929        }
 930
 931        function autoDetectGps() {
 932            const gpsDot = document.getElementById('gps-dot');
 933            const gpsText = document.getElementById('gps-text');
 934
 935            if ('geolocation' in navigator) {
 936                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
 937                    (pos) => {
 938                        userCoords = { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude };
 939                        gpsDot.style.background = '#10b981';
 940                        gpsDot.style.boxShadow = '0 0 8px #10b981';
 941                        gpsText.textContent = `${userCoords.lat.toFixed(3)}, ${userCoords.lng.toFixed(3)}`;
 942                        updateUserMarker();
 943                    },
 944                    (err) => {
 945                        console.log('GPS error/permission denied, fallback to default center:', err.message);
 946                        gpsDot.style.background = '#f59e0b';
 947                        gpsText.textContent = 'GPS Standby';
 948                    },
 949                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 5000 }
 950                );
 951            }
 952        }
 953
 954        function locateUser() {
 955            if (userCoords) {
 956                map.flyTo([userCoords.lat, userCoords.lng], 15, { duration: 1 });
 957            } else {
 958                autoDetectGps();
 959            }
 960        }
 961
 962        function updateUserMarker() {
 963            if (!userCoords) return;
 964            if (userMarker) {
 965                userMarker.setLatLng([userCoords.lat, userCoords.lng]);
 966            } else {
 967                const userIcon = L.divIcon({
 968                    className: 'custom-user-icon',
 969                    html: '<div style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#38bdf8;border:3px solid #ffffff;box-shadow:0 0 14px #38bdf8;"></div>',
 970                    iconSize: [18, 18],
 971                    iconAnchor: [9, 9]
 972                });
 973                userMarker = L.marker([userCoords.lat, userCoords.lng], { icon: userIcon }).addTo(map).bindPopup('📍 Posisi Anda');
 974            }
 975        }
 976
 977        // Hitung Rute Menggunakan OSRM
 978        async function calculateRoute(destLat, destLng, destName) {
 979            const originLat = userCoords ? userCoords.lat : PADANG_CENTER[0];
 980            const originLng = userCoords ? userCoords.lng : PADANG_CENTER[1];
 981
 982            const routeBadge = document.getElementById('route-info');
 983            const routeName = document.getElementById('route-dest-name');
 984            const routeStats = document.getElementById('route-stats');
 985
 986            routeName.textContent = `Menghubungkan ke ${destName}...`;
 987            routeStats.textContent = 'Mengambil polyline OSRM...';
 988            routeBadge.style.display = 'flex';
 989
 990            const osrmUrl = `https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/${originLng},${originLat};${destLng},${destLat}?overview=full&geometries=geojson`;
 991
 992            try {
 993                const res = await fetch(osrmUrl);
 994                const data = await res.json();
 995
 996                if (data.routes && data.routes.length > 0) {
 997                    const route = data.routes[0];
 998                    const distanceKm = (route.distance / 1000).toFixed(1);
 999                    const durationMins = Math.round(route.duration / 60);
1000
1001                    routeLayer.clearLayers();
1002
1003                    const polyline = L.geoJSON(route.geometry, {
1004                        style: {
1005                            color: '#38bdf8',
1006                            weight: 5,
1007                            opacity: 0.9,
1008                            dashArray: '1, 6',
1009                            lineCap: 'round'
1010                        }
1011                    }).addTo(routeLayer);
1012
1013                    map.fitBounds(polyline.getBounds().pad(0.2));
1014
1015                    routeName.textContent = destName;
1016                    routeStats.textContent = `Jarak Rute: ${distanceKm} km • Estimasi Tempuh: ~${durationMins} menit`;
1017                } else {
1018                    routeStats.textContent = 'Jalur rute OSRM tidak ditemukan.';
1019                }
1020            } catch (e) {
1021                console.error('OSRM route error:', e);
1022                routeStats.textContent = 'Gagal memuat rute dari peladen OSRM.';
1023            }
1024        }
1025
1026        function clearRoute() {
1027            routeLayer.clearLayers();
1028            document.getElementById('route-info').style.display = 'none';
1029        }
1030
1031        // Chat Interaction Functions
1032        function askPreset(text) {
1033            document.getElementById('chat-input').value = text;
1034            handleSend(new Event('submit'));
1035        }
1036
1037        function askAboutPlace(name) {
1038            document.getElementById('chat-input').value = `Informasi lengkap mengenai ${name}`;
1039            handleSend(new Event('submit'));
1040        }
1041
1042        async function handleSend(e) {
1043            e.preventDefault();
1044            const input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
1045            const text = input.value.trim();
1046            if (!text) return;
1047
1048            input.value = '';
1049            appendUserMessage(text);
1050
1051            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('btn-submit');
1052            submitBtn.disabled = true;
1053            document.getElementById('typing-indicator').style.display = 'flex';
1054
1055            const payload = {
1056                message: text,
1057                session_token: sessionToken,
1058                latitude: userCoords ? userCoords.lat : null,
1059                longitude: userCoords ? userCoords.lng : null
1060            };
1061
1062            try {
1063                const chatApiUrl = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/api/chat';
1064                const res = await fetch(chatApiUrl, {
1065                    method: 'POST',
1066                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
1067                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
1068                });
1069                const data = await res.json();
1070
1071                if (data.session_token) {
1072                    sessionToken = data.session_token;
1073                    localStorage.setItem('geo_session_token', sessionToken);
1074                }
1075
1076                appendAssistantMessage(data);
1077
1078                // Update marker & sorot peta jika ada places
1079                if (data.places && data.places.length > 0) {
1080                    plotPlaces(data.places);
1081                    const group = L.featureGroup(markersLayer.getLayers());
1082                    map.fitBounds(group.getBounds().pad(0.3));
1083                }
1084            } catch (err) {
1085                console.error('Chat error:', err);
1086                appendAssistantMessage({
1087                    response: 'Terjadi kendala jaringan saat menghubungi layanan asisten spasial.'
1088                });
1089            } finally {
1090                submitBtn.disabled = false;
1091                document.getElementById('typing-indicator').style.display = 'none';
1092            }
1093        }
1094
1095        function appendUserMessage(text) {
1096            const container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
1097            const el = document.createElement('div');
1098            el.className = 'message-bubble user';
1099            el.innerHTML = `
1100                <div class="bubble-body">${escapeHtml(text)}</div>
1101                <div class="bubble-meta">Anda • ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}</div>
1102            `;
1103            container.appendChild(el);
1104            container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
1105        }
1106
1107        function appendAssistantMessage(data) {
1108            const container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
1109            const el = document.createElement('div');
1110            el.className = 'message-bubble assistant';
1111
1112            // Format markdown text sederhana (bold, list, bullet)
1113            let formattedText = escapeHtml(data.response || '')
1114                .replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
1115                .replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
1116                .replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
1117
1118            // Place mini cards jika ada destinasi
1119            let placesHtml = '';
1120            if (data.places && data.places.length > 0) {
1121                placesHtml = '<div class="place-cards-carousel">';
1122                data.places.forEach(p => {
1123                    const tiket = p.harga_tiket == 0 ? 'Gratis' : 'Rp' + parseInt(p.harga_tiket).toLocaleString('id-ID');
1124                    const jarak = p.jarak_km ? `${parseFloat(p.jarak_km).toFixed(1)} km` : '';
1125                    placesHtml += `
1126                        <div class="place-mini-card">
1127                            <img src="${p.foto}" class="place-mini-img">
1128                            <div class="place-mini-content">
1129                                <span class="place-mini-badge">${p.kategori || 'Wisata'}</span>
1130                                <div class="place-mini-title">${escapeHtml(p.nama)}</div>
1131                                <div class="place-mini-details">
1132                                    <span>🎫 ${tiket}</span>
1133                                    ${jarak ? `<span>📍 ${jarak}</span>` : ''}
1134                                </div>
1135                                <div class="place-mini-actions">
1136                                    <button class="btn-mini btn-mini-view" onclick="focusOnPoi(${p.id}, ${p.lat}, ${p.lng})">Peta</button>
1137                                    <button class="btn-mini btn-mini-route" onclick="calculateRoute(${p.lat}, ${p.lng}, '${escapeHtml(p.nama)}')">Rute</button>
1138                                </div>
1139                            </div>
1140                        </div>
1141                    `;
1142                });
1143                placesHtml += '</div>';
1144            }
1145
1146            // CSIR Inspector Accordion untuk audit riset
1147            let csirHtml = '';
1148            if (data.sir) {
1149                const sirJson = JSON.stringify(data.sir, null, 2);
1150                csirHtml = `
1151                    <div class="csir-inspector">
1152                        <div class="csir-toggle" onclick="toggleCsir(this)">
1153                            <span>🔬 CSIR Inspector [${data.sir.control_metadata.validation_status}]</span>
1154                            <span>▾</span>
1155                        </div>
1156                        <div class="csir-content">${escapeHtml(sirJson)}</div>
1157                    </div>
1158                `;
1159            }
1160
1161            el.innerHTML = `
1162                <div class="bubble-body">
1163                    ${formattedText}
1164                    ${placesHtml}
1165                    ${csirHtml}
1166                </div>
1167                <div class="bubble-meta">Asisten Spasial • MySQL 8.0 • ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}</div>
1168            `;
1169
1170            container.appendChild(el);
1171            container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
1172        }
1173
1174        function focusOnPoi(id, lat, lng) {
1175            map.flyTo([lat, lng], 16, { duration: 1 });
1176            markersLayer.eachLayer(layer => {
1177                if (layer.poiId == id) {
1178                    layer.openPopup();
1179                }
1180            });
1181        }
1182
1183        function toggleCsir(headerEl) {
1184            const content = headerEl.nextElementSibling;
1185            if (content.style.display === 'block') {
1186                content.style.display = 'none';
1187                headerEl.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent = '▾';
1188            } else {
1189                content.style.display = 'block';
1190                headerEl.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent = '▴';
1191            }
1192        }
1193
1194        function escapeHtml(text) {
1195            const div = document.createElement('div');
1196            div.textContent = text;
1197            return div.innerHTML;
1198        }
1199
1200        // Auto-run query from URL param (useful for research evaluations & screenshots)
1201        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
1202            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
1203            const q = params.get('q');
1204            if (q) {
1205                setTimeout(async () => {
1206                    const input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
1207                    if (input) {
1208                        input.value = q;
1209                        await handleSend(new Event('submit'));
1210                        if (params.get('route')) {
1211                            setTimeout(() => {
1212                                calculateRoute(-0.958742, 100.354128, 'Pantai Padang');
1213                            }, 1200);
1214                        }
1215                        if (params.get('open_csir')) {
1216                            setTimeout(() => {
1217                                document.querySelectorAll('.csir-toggle').forEach(el => el.click());
1218                            }, 1500);
1219                        }
1220                    }
1221                }, 800);
1222            }
1223        });
1224    </script>
1225</body>
1226</html>

 174
 175            // === 1. LAYER A: Field-Level Semantic CSIR Comparison ===
 176            // Ekstraksi niat murni pengguna (Pre-fallback Intent CSIR - No Intent Alteration)
 177            $actualCsirArray = $this->extractActualCsirArray($sir);
 178            $fieldMatches = $this->compareCsirFields($expectedCsir, $actualCsirArray, $case);
 179            $isExactCsir = $this->isExactCsirMatch($fieldMatches);
 180            if ($isExactCsir) {
 181                $exactCsirMatches++;
 182            }
 183
 184            // Envelope eksekusi: memperhitungkan resolusi kebijakan batas operasional (Post-policy resolution)
 185            $actualEnvelopeArray = $this->extractActualExecutionEnvelopeArray($sir);
 186            $envelopeFieldMatches = $this->compareCsirFields($expectedCsir, $actualEnvelopeArray, $case);
 187            $isEnvelopeMatch = $this->isExactCsirMatch($envelopeFieldMatches);
 188            if ($isEnvelopeMatch) {
 189                $executionEnvelopeMatches++;
 190            }
 191
 192            foreach ($fieldMatches as $field => $status) {
 193                if ($status !== 'NOT_APPLICABLE') {
 194                    $fieldMatchesAccumulator[$field]['applicable']++;
 195                    if ($status === 'MATCH') {
 196                        $fieldMatchesAccumulator[$field]['correct']++;
 197                    }
 198                }
 199            }
 200
 201            // === 2. LAYER B: Deterministic Validation Evaluation ===
 202            $expectedValid = $case['expected_valid'] ?? (!$expectedCsir['is_out_of_scope']);
 203            $expectedPolicy = $case['expected_policy'] ?? ($expectedCsir['is_out_of_scope'] ? 'reject_out_of_scope' : 'execute_sql');
 204
 205            $validationMatch = ($sir->isValid === $expectedValid && $sir->executionPolicy === $expectedPolicy);
 206            if ($validationMatch) {
 207                $validationMatches++;
 208            }
 209
 210            $isOutOfScopeCase = ($expectedCsir['is_out_of_scope'] === true);
 211            $honestRejectionSuccess = false;
 212            if ($isOutOfScopeCase) {
 213                $totalOutOfScopeCases++;
 214                if ($sir->isOutOfScope && $sir->executionPolicy === 'reject_out_of_scope' && count($places) === 0) {
 215                    $honestRejectionSuccess = true;
 216                    $honestRejectionCount++;
 217                }
 218            }
 219
 220            // Klasifikasi Tipe Skenario Pengujian
 221            $isChitchatCase = ($case['is_sapaan'] ?? false) || ($expectedCsir['intent'] === 'general_inquiry');
 222            $isPureSpatialCase = !$isChitchatCase && !$isOutOfScopeCase;
 223
 224            if ($isPureSpatialCase) {
 225                $totalSpatialCases++;
 226            } elseif ($isChitchatCase) {
 227                $totalChitchatCases++;
 228            }
 229
 230            // === 3. LAYER C: Spatial Execution & Predicate Correctness ===
 231            $spatialPredicateCorrect = $this->evaluateSpatialPredicate($case, $sir, $places);
 232            if ($spatialPredicateCorrect) {
 233                $spatialPredicateMatches++;
 234                if ($isPureSpatialCase) {
 235                    $pureSpatialMatches++;
 236                } elseif ($isChitchatCase) {
 237                    $chitchatMatches++;
 238                }
 239            }
 240
 241            // === 4. LAYER D: Grounded Generation Evaluation ===
 242            $groundingEvaluation = $this->evaluateGrounding($reply, $places, $groundingValidator, $sir, $case);
 243            $totalVerifiableClaims  += $groundingEvaluation['verifiable_claims'];
 244            $totalSupportedClaims   += $groundingEvaluation['supported_claims'];
 245            $totalMentionedEntities += $groundingEvaluation['mentioned_entities'];
 246            $totalGroundedEntities  += $groundingEvaluation['grounded_entities'];
 247            $totalFabricatedEntities += $groundingEvaluation['fabricated_entities'];
 248
 249            // Simpan Data Per-Kasus
 250            $scenarioResults[] = [
 251                'id'                            => $caseId,
 252                'grup'                          => $case['grup'],
 253                'prompt'                        => $prompt,
 254                'scenario_type'                 => $isPureSpatialCase ? 'pure_spatial' : ($isChitchatCase ? 'chit_chat' : 'out_of_scope'),
 255                'expected'                      => $expectedCsir,
 256                'predicted_intent_csir'         => $actualCsirArray,
 257                'resolved_execution_envelope'   => $actualEnvelopeArray,
 258                'field_matches'                 => $fieldMatches,
 259                'envelope_field_matches'        => $envelopeFieldMatches,
 260                'exact_csir_match'              => $isExactCsir,
 261                'envelope_match'                => $isEnvelopeMatch,
 262                'validation_match'              => $validationMatch,
 263                'spatial_predicate_match'       => $spatialPredicateCorrect,
 264                'grounding'                     => $groundingEvaluation,
 265                'places_count'                  => count($places),
 266                'fallback_applied'              => $sir->fallbackApplied,
 267                'fallback_notice'               => $sir->fallbackNotice,
 268                'timings'                       => $timing,
 269            ];
 270
 271            if (!$isJsonOnly) {
 272                $mismatchCount = 0;
 273                foreach ($fieldMatches as $st) {
 274                    if ($st === 'MISMATCH') {
 275                        $mismatchCount++;
 276                    }
 277                }
 278
 279                $statusLabel = $isExactCsir ? 'EXACT_OK' : ($mismatchCount === 0 ? 'OK' : "MISMATCH({$mismatchCount})");
 280                CLI::write(sprintf(
 281                    "[%02d/%02d] %-30s | CSIR: %-12s | Valid: %-3s | SpatPred: %-3s | Claims: %02d/%02d | %5.1f ms",
 282                    $caseId,
 283                    $totalTest,
 284                    substr($case['grup'], 0, 30),
 285                    $statusLabel,
 286                    $validationMatch ? 'YES' : 'NO',
 287                    $spatialPredicateCorrect ? 'YES' : 'NO',
 288                    $groundingEvaluation['supported_claims'],
 289                    $groundingEvaluation['verifiable_claims'],
 290                    $timing['total_ms']
 291                ));
 292            }
 293        }
 294
 295        // Agregasi Metrik
 296        $aggregated = $this->aggregateMetrics(
 297            $scenarioResults,
 298            $fieldMatchesAccumulator,
 299            $totalTest,
 300            $exactCsirMatches,
 301            $executionEnvelopeMatches,
 302            $validationMatches,
 303            $spatialPredicateMatches,
 304            $pureSpatialMatches,
 305            $totalSpatialCases,
 306            $chitchatMatches,
 307            $totalChitchatCases,
 308            $honestRejectionCount,
 309            $totalOutOfScopeCases,
 310            $totalSupportedClaims,
 311            $totalVerifiableClaims,
 312            $totalGroundedEntities,
 313            $totalMentionedEntities,
 314            $totalFabricatedEntities,
 315            $timings,
 316            $mode
 317        );
 318
 319        if ($isJsonOnly) {
 320            CLI::write(json_encode($aggregated, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
 321            return;
 322        }
 323
 324        // Tampilkan Laporan Konsol Rinci
 325        $this->renderConsoleReport($aggregated, $scenarioResults);
 326
 327        // Simpan Hasil JSON ke disk
 328        $reportPath = WRITEPATH . 'riset_evaluasi_mysql.json';
 329        file_put_contents($reportPath, json_encode($aggregated, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
 330
 331        // Buat dan simpan matriks audit traceability per-kasus (Markdown & JSON)
 332        $traceabilityMd = $this->generateTraceabilityMatrix($scenarioResults);
 333        file_put_contents(WRITEPATH . 'csir_case_traceability_matrix.md', $traceabilityMd);
 334        file_put_contents(WRITEPATH . 'csir_case_traceability_matrix.json', json_encode($scenarioResults, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
 335
 336        $projectRoot = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
 337        if (is_dir($projectRoot . '/benchmark')) {
 338            file_put_contents($projectRoot . '/benchmark/csir_case_traceability_matrix.md', $traceabilityMd);
 339            file_put_contents($projectRoot . '/benchmark/csir_case_traceability_matrix.json', json_encode($scenarioResults, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE));
 340        }
 341        if (is_dir($projectRoot . '/jurnal')) {
 342            file_put_contents($projectRoot . '/jurnal/TABEL_TRACEABILITY_CSIR_40_KASUS.md', $traceabilityMd);
 343        }
 344
 345        CLI::write("\n[✓] Laporan evaluasi berhasil disimpan ke: {$reportPath}", 'cyan');
 346        CLI::write("[✓] Matriks audit per-kasus disimpan ke: benchmark/csir_case_traceability_matrix.md\n", 'cyan');
 347    }

 349    /**
 350     * Membandingkan setiap field CSIR antara expected dan predicted.
 351     *
 352     * @param array<string, mixed> $expected
 353     * @param array<string, mixed> $actual
 354     * @param array<string, mixed> $case
 355     * @return array<string, string> 'MATCH'|'MISMATCH'|'NOT_APPLICABLE'
 356     */
 357    private function compareCsirFields(array $expected, array $actual, array $case): array
 358    {
 359        $result = [];
 360        foreach (self::CSIR_FIELDS as $field) {
 361            if (!$this->isFieldApplicable($field, $expected, $case)) {
 362                $result[$field] = 'NOT_APPLICABLE';
 363                continue;
 364            }
 365
 366            $expVal = $expected[$field] ?? null;
 367            if ($field === 'latitude' && !empty($case['lat'])) {
 368                $expVal = (float) $case['lat'];
 369            } elseif ($field === 'longitude' && !empty($case['lng'])) {
 370                $expVal = (float) $case['lng'];
 371            }
 372            $actVal = $actual[$field] ?? null;
 373
 374            $result[$field] = $this->compareField($field, $expVal, $actVal);
 375        }
 376
 377        return $result;
 378    }
 379
 380    /**
 381     * Menentukan apakah suatu field relevan/berlaku untuk dievaluasi pada skenario ini.
 382     */
 383    private function isFieldApplicable(string $field, array $expected, array $case): bool
 384    {
 385        // Field wajib selalu berlaku
 386        if (in_array($field, self::REQUIRED_FIELDS, true)) {
 387            return true;
 388        }
 389
 390        // Jika ground truth memiliki nilai non-null eksplisit, field tersebut berlaku
 391        if (array_key_exists($field, $expected) && $expected[$field] !== null) {
 392            return true;
 393        }
 394
 395        // Jika field berupa boolean konstrain dan expected bernilai true, field berlaku
 396        if (in_array($field, ['is_free', 'open_now', 'open_24h'], true)) {
 397            return !empty($expected[$field]);
 398        }
 399
 400        // Koordinat berlaku jika case menyediakan koordinat GPS
 401        if (in_array($field, ['latitude', 'longitude'], true)) {
 402            return !empty($case['lat']) || !empty($case['lng']);
 403        }
 404
 405        return false;
 406    }
 407
 408    /**
 409     * Membandingkan nilai field tunggal sesuai tipe datanya.
 410     */
 411    private function compareField(string $field, $expected, $actual): string
 412    {
 413        return match (true) {
 414            in_array($field, ['radius', 'latitude', 'longitude'], true)
 415                => $this->compareFloat($expected, $actual),
 416            in_array($field, ['max_price'], true)
 417                => $this->compareNumeric($expected, $actual),
 418            in_array($field, ['is_free', 'open_now', 'open_24h', 'is_out_of_scope'], true)
 419                => $this->compareBoolean($expected, $actual),
 420            default
 421                => $this->compareNormalized($field, $expected, $actual),
 422        };
 423    }
 424
 425    /**
 426     * Perbandingan float dengan toleransi numerik.
 427     */
 428    private function compareFloat($expected, $actual, float $tolerance = 0.001): string
 429    {
 430        if ($expected === null && $actual === null) {
 431            return 'MATCH';
 432        }
 433        if ($expected === null || $actual === null) {
 434            return 'MISMATCH';
 435        }
 436        return abs((float) $expected - (float) $actual) <= $tolerance ? 'MATCH' : 'MISMATCH';
 437    }
 438
 439    /**
 440     * Perbandingan numerik integer/float eksak.
 441     */
 442    private function compareNumeric($expected, $actual): string
 443    {
 444        if ($expected === null && $actual === null) {
 445            return 'MATCH';
 446        }
 447        if ($expected === null || $actual === null) {
 448            return 'MISMATCH';
 449        }
 450        return ((float) $expected === (float) $actual) ? 'MATCH' : 'MISMATCH';
 451    }
 452
 453    /**
 454     * Perbandingan boolean ketat.
 455     */
 456    private function compareBoolean($expected, $actual): string
 457    {
 458        if ($expected === null && $actual === null) {
 459            return 'MATCH';
 460        }
 461        if ($expected === null || $actual === null) {
 462            return 'MISMATCH';
 463        }
 464        return ((bool) $expected === (bool) $actual) ? 'MATCH' : 'MISMATCH';
 465    }
 466
 467    /**
 468     * Perbandingan string/enum ternormalisasi.
 469     */
 470    private function compareNormalized(string $field, $expected, $actual): string
 471    {
 472        $normExp = $this->normalizeValue($field, $expected);
 473        $normAct = $this->normalizeValue($field, $actual);
 474
 475        if ($normExp === null && $normAct === null) {
 476            return 'MATCH';
 477        }
 478        if ($normExp === null || $normAct === null) {
 479            return 'MISMATCH';
 480        }
 481
 482        return (strcasecmp((string) $normExp, (string) $normAct) === 0) ? 'MATCH' : 'MISMATCH';
 483    }
 484
 485    /**
 486     * Normalisasi nilai semantik untuk mencegah kesalahan trivial format string.
 487     */
 488    private function normalizeValue(string $field, $value)
 489    {
 490        if ($value === null) {
 491            return null;
 492        }
 493        if (is_string($value)) {
 494            $value = trim($value);
 495            if ($value === '') {
 496                return null;
 497            }
 498        }
 499
 500        return match ($field) {
 501            'spatial_operator' => str_replace(' ', '_', strtolower((string) $value)),
 502            'reference_type'   => strtolower((string) $value),
 503            'distance_unit'    => strtolower((string) $value),
 504            'sort'             => strtolower((string) $value),
 505            default            => $value,
 506        };
 507    }
 508
 509    /**
 510     * Exact CSIR Match: bernilai true jika seluruh applicable field berstatus MATCH (tanpa satupun MISMATCH).
 511     */
 512    private function isExactCsirMatch(array $fieldMatches): bool
 513    {
 514        foreach ($fieldMatches as $status) {
 515            if ($status === 'MISMATCH') {
 516                return false;
 517            }
 518        }
 519        return true;
 520    }
 521
 522    /**
 523     * Ekstraksi atribut CSIR dari objek SpatialIntent menjadi array asosiatif 19-field.
 524     *
 525     * @param SpatialIntent $sir
 526     * @return array<string, mixed>
 527     */
 528    private function extractActualCsirArray(SpatialIntent $sir): array
 529    {
 530        return [
 531            'intent'           => $sir->intent,
 532            'entity'           => $sir->entity,
 533            'category'         => $sir->category,
 534            'target_name'      => $sir->targetName,
 535            'keyword'          => $sir->keyword,
 536            'spatial_operator' => $sir->spatialOperator,
 537            'reference_type'   => $sir->referenceType,
 538            'reference_entity' => $sir->referenceEntity,
 539            'latitude'         => $sir->latitude,
 540            'longitude'        => $sir->longitude,
 541            'radius'           => $sir->radius,
 542            'distance_unit'    => $sir->distanceUnit,
 543            'admin_area'       => $sir->adminArea,
 544            'is_free'          => $sir->isFree,
 545            'max_price'        => $sir->maxPrice,
 546            'open_now'         => $sir->openNow,
 547            'open_24h'         => $sir->open24h,
 548            'sort'             => $sir->sort,
 549            'is_out_of_scope'  => $sir->isOutOfScope,
 550        ];
 551    }
 552
 553    /**
 554     * Evaluasi Spatial Predicate Correctness (Layer C).
 555     */
 556    private function evaluateSpatialPredicate(array $case, SpatialIntent $sir, array $places): bool
 557    {
 558        // 1. Kasus Out-of-Scope / Expect Empty
 559        if (($case['expect_empty'] ?? false) || ($case['expected_csir']['is_out_of_scope'] ?? false)) {
 560            return count($places) === 0;
 561        }
 562
 563        // 2. Verifikasi Konsistensi Kebijakan Fallback Lokasi Luar Jangkauan (> 35 km)
 564        if ($sir->latitude !== null && $sir->longitude !== null) {
 565            $distFromCenter = $this->calculateDistanceKm(
 566                $sir->latitude,
 567                $sir->longitude,
 568                SpatialPolicyHandler::PADANG_CENTER_LAT,
 569                SpatialPolicyHandler::PADANG_CENTER_LNG
 570            );
 571            if ($distFromCenter > SpatialPolicyHandler::SERVICE_AREA_THRESHOLD_KM && !$sir->fallbackApplied) {
 572                return false;
 573            }
 574        }
 575
 576        // 3. Verifikasi Predikat Operator Radius: d <= R
 577        if ($sir->spatialOperator === 'within_radius' && $sir->radius !== null) {
 578            if (empty($places)) {
 579                return true;
 580            }
 581            foreach ($places as $p) {
 582                if (isset($p['jarak_km']) && is_numeric($p['jarak_km'])) {
 583                    if ((float) $p['jarak_km'] > ($sir->radius + 0.1)) {
 584                        return false;
 585                    }
 586                }
 587            }
 588        }
 589
 590        // 4. Verifikasi Predikat Wilayah Administratif: POI.admin_area == expected_admin_area
 591        if ($sir->spatialOperator === 'within_admin_area' && !empty($sir->adminArea)) {
 592            if (empty($places)) {
 593                return true;
 594            }
 595            $targetArea = strtolower($sir->adminArea);
 596            foreach ($places as $p) {
 597                $addr = strtolower($p['alamat'] ?? '');
 598                if (!str_contains($addr, $targetArea)) {
 599                    return false;
 600                }
 601            }
 602        }
 603
 604        // 5. Verifikasi Predikat Urutan Terdekat: returned POI == argmin(distance)
 605        if ($sir->spatialOperator === 'nearest' || $sir->sort === 'terdekat') {
 606            if (count($places) >= 1) {
 607                $firstDist = isset($places[0]['jarak_km']) ? (float) $places[0]['jarak_km'] : null;
 608                $prevDist = -1.0;
 609                foreach ($places as $p) {
 610                    if (isset($p['jarak_km']) && is_numeric($p['jarak_km'])) {
 611                        $currDist = (float) $p['jarak_km'];
 612                        // Verifikasi POI pertama adalah argmin jarak
 613                        if ($firstDist !== null && $currDist < ($firstDist - 0.01)) {
 614                            return false;
 615                        }
 616                        // Verifikasi urutan monotonik naik
 617                        if ($prevDist >= 0.0 && $currDist < ($prevDist - 0.01)) {
 618                            return false;
 619                        }
 620                        $prevDist = $currDist;
 621                    }
 622                }
 623            }
 624        }
 625
 626        // 6. Verifikasi Predikat Tiket Gratis Murni
 627        if ($sir->isFree && ($sir->maxPrice === null || $sir->maxPrice === 0)) {
 628            foreach ($places as $p) {
 629                if (isset($p['harga_tiket']) && (int) $p['harga_tiket'] !== 0) {
 630                    return false;
 631                }
 632            }
 633        }
 634
 635        // 7. Verifikasi Predikat Batas Anggaran Maksimum
 636        if ($sir->maxPrice !== null && $sir->maxPrice > 0) {
 637            foreach ($places as $p) {
 638                if (isset($p['harga_tiket']) && (int) $p['harga_tiket'] > $sir->maxPrice) {
 639                    return false;
 640                }
 641            }
 642        }
 643
 644        // 8. Verifikasi Predikat Kategori: POI.category == expected_category
 645        $expectedCategory = $case['expected_kategori'] ?? $case['expected_csir']['category'] ?? $sir->category;
 646        if ($expectedCategory !== null && !empty($places)) {
 647            foreach ($places as $p) {
 648                if (isset($p['kategori']) && strcasecmp(trim($p['kategori']), trim($expectedCategory)) !== 0) {
 649                    return false;
 650                }
 651            }
 652        }
 653
 654        return true;
 655    }
 656
 657    /**
 658     * Hitung jarak lingkaran besar (Great-Circle Distance) dalam kilometer.
 659     */
 660    private function calculateDistanceKm(float $lat1, float $lon1, float $lat2, float $lon2): float
 661    {
 662        $radLat1 = deg2rad($lat1);
 663        $radLat2 = deg2rad($lat2);
 664        $radDeltaLon = deg2rad($lon2 - $lon1);
 665
 666        $cosVal = sin($radLat1) * sin($radLat2) + cos($radLat1) * cos($radLat2) * cos($radDeltaLon);
 667        $cosVal = max(-1.0, min(1.0, $cosVal));
 668
 669        return 6371.0 * acos($cosVal);
 670    }
 671
 672    /**
 673     * Evaluasi Grounded NLG Synthesis & Algorithmic Grounding Validation (Layer D).
 674     */
 675    private function evaluateGrounding(string $reply, array $places, GroundingValidator $validator, SpatialIntent $sir, array $case): array
 676    {
 677        // Kasus out-of-scope yang ditolak jujur
 678        if (($case['expected_csir']['is_out_of_scope'] ?? false) && $sir->executionPolicy === 'reject_out_of_scope') {
 679            return [
 680                'is_grounded'         => true,
 681                'verifiable_claims'   => 0,
 682                'supported_claims'    => 0,
 683                'claim_fidelity'      => 100.0,
 684                'mentioned_entities'  => 0,
 685                'grounded_entities'   => 0,
 686                'entity_fidelity'     => 100.0,
 687                'fabricated_entities' => 0,
 688                'violations'          => [],
 689            ];
 690        }
 691
 692        $res = $validator->validate($reply, $places);
 693        $claimStats = $res['claimStats'];
 694        $fabEntities = $res['fabricatedEntities'];
 695
 696        $validPoisInDb = array_column($places, 'nama');
 697        $mentionedCount = 0;
 698        $groundedCount = 0;
 699
 700        foreach ($validPoisInDb as $poi) {
 701            if (stripos($reply, $poi) !== false) {
 702                $mentionedCount++;
 703                $groundedCount++;
 704            }
 705        }
 706        $mentionedCount += count($fabEntities);
 707
 708        $entityFidelity = $mentionedCount > 0 ? (100.0 * $groundedCount / $mentionedCount) : 100.0;
 709
 710        return [
 711            'is_grounded'         => $res['isGrounded'],
 712            'verifiable_claims'   => $claimStats['totalClaims'],
 713            'supported_claims'    => $claimStats['supportedClaims'],
 714            'claim_fidelity'      => $claimStats['fidelity'],
 715            'mentioned_entities'  => $mentionedCount,
 716            'grounded_entities'   => $groundedCount,
 717            'entity_fidelity'     => $entityFidelity,
 718            'fabricated_entities' => count($fabEntities),
 719            'violations'          => $res['violations'],
 720        ];
 721    }
 722
 723    /**
 724     * Fallback penyusun expected CSIR dari struktur lama jika field expected_csir belum ada.
 725     */
 726    private function buildFallbackExpectedCsir(array $case): array
 727    {
 728        $filters = $case['expected_filters'] ?? [];
 729        $isOutOfScope = !empty($case['is_out_of_scope']) 
 730            || (!empty($case['expected_policy']) && $case['expected_policy'] === 'reject_out_of_scope')
 731            || (isset($case['grup']) && str_contains(strtolower((string) $case['grup']), 'out-of-scope'));
 732
 733        return [
 734            'intent'           => $case['is_sapaan'] ? 'general_inquiry' : (!empty($case['expected_nama']) ? 'entity_lookup' : 'spatial_recommendation'),
 735            'entity'           => 'tourism_object',
 736            'category'         => $case['expected_kategori'] ?? null,
 737            'target_name'      => $case['expected_nama'] ?? null,
 738            'keyword'          => $filters['kata_kunci'] ?? null,
 739            'spatial_operator' => isset($filters['urutan']) && $filters['urutan'] === 'terdekat' ? 'nearest' : (isset($filters['wilayah']) ? 'within_admin_area' : 'none'),
 740            'reference_type'   => isset($case['lat'], $case['lng']) && $case['lat'] !== null ? 'gps' : 'unknown',
 741            'reference_entity' => null,
 742            'latitude'         => isset($case['lat']) && is_numeric($case['lat']) ? (float) $case['lat'] : null,
 743            'longitude'        => isset($case['lng']) && is_numeric($case['lng']) ? (float) $case['lng'] : null,
 744            'radius'           => null,
 745            'distance_unit'    => 'km',
 746            'admin_area'       => $filters['wilayah'] ?? null,
 747            'is_free'          => $filters['gratis'] ?? false,
 748            'max_price'        => $filters['max_harga'] ?? null,
 749            'open_now'         => $filters['jam_sekarang'] ?? false,
 750            'open_24h'         => $filters['buka_24_jam'] ?? false,
 751            'sort'             => $filters['urutan'] ?? null,
 752            'is_out_of_scope'  => $isOutOfScope,
 753        ];
 754    }

 756    /**
 757     * Ekstraksi atribut envelope eksekusi (setelah resolusi batas kebijakan spasial).
 758     *
 759     * @param SpatialIntent $sir
 760     * @return array<string, mixed>
 761     */
 762    private function extractActualExecutionEnvelopeArray(SpatialIntent $sir): array
 763    {
 764        $arr = $this->extractActualCsirArray($sir);
 765        if ($sir->fallbackApplied) {
 766            $arr['reference_type'] = $sir->getExecutionReferenceType();
 767            $arr['latitude'] = $sir->getExecutionLatitude();
 768            $arr['longitude'] = $sir->getExecutionLongitude();
 769        }
 770        return $arr;
 771    }

 773    /**
 774     * Agregasi seluruh metrik pengujian.
 775     */
 776    private function aggregateMetrics(
 777        array $scenarioResults,
 778        array $fieldMatchesAccumulator,
 779        int $totalTest,
 780        int $exactCsirMatches,
 781        int $executionEnvelopeMatches,
 782        int $validationMatches,
 783        int $spatialPredicateMatches,
 784        int $pureSpatialMatches,
 785        int $totalSpatialCases,
 786        int $chitchatMatches,
 787        int $totalChitchatCases,
 788        int $honestRejectionCount,
 789        int $totalOutOfScopeCases,
 790        int $totalSupportedClaims,
 791        int $totalVerifiableClaims,
 792        int $totalGroundedEntities,
 793        int $totalMentionedEntities,
 794        int $totalFabricatedEntities,
 795        array $timings,
 796        string $mode
 797    ): array {
 798        $fieldAccuracies = [];
 799        foreach ($fieldMatchesAccumulator as $field => $data) {
 800            $acc = $data['applicable'] > 0 ? (100.0 * $data['correct'] / $data['applicable']) : null;
 801            $fieldAccuracies[$field] = [
 802                'applicable' => $data['applicable'],
 803                'correct'    => $data['correct'],
 804                'accuracy'   => $acc !== null ? round($acc, 2) : 100.0,
 805            ];
 806        }
 807
 808        // Sub-dimensi
 809        $calcSubDim = function(array $fields) use ($fieldAccuracies) {
 810            $app = 0;
 811            $corr = 0;
 812            foreach ($fields as $f) {
 813                if (isset($fieldAccuracies[$f])) {
 814                    $app += $fieldAccuracies[$f]['applicable'];
 815                    $corr += $fieldAccuracies[$f]['correct'];
 816                }
 817            }
 818            return $app > 0 ? round(100.0 * $corr / $app, 2) : 100.0;
 819        };
 820
 821        $exactCsirAcc = $totalTest > 0 ? round(100.0 * $exactCsirMatches / $totalTest, 2) : 0.0;
 822        $envelopeAcc  = $totalTest > 0 ? round(100.0 * $executionEnvelopeMatches / $totalTest, 2) : 0.0;
 823        $valDecisionAcc = $totalTest > 0 ? round(100.0 * $validationMatches / $totalTest, 2) : 0.0;
 824        $spatialPredAcc = $totalTest > 0 ? round(100.0 * $spatialPredicateMatches / $totalTest, 2) : 0.0;
 825        $pureSpatialAcc = $totalSpatialCases > 0 ? round(100.0 * $pureSpatialMatches / $totalSpatialCases, 2) : 100.0;
 826        $chitchatAcc    = $totalChitchatCases > 0 ? round(100.0 * $chitchatMatches / $totalChitchatCases, 2) : 100.0;
 827        $hrr = $totalOutOfScopeCases > 0 ? round(100.0 * $honestRejectionCount / $totalOutOfScopeCases, 2) : 100.0;
 828        $cgf = $totalVerifiableClaims > 0 ? round(100.0 * $totalSupportedClaims / $totalVerifiableClaims, 2) : 100.0;
 829        $egf = $totalMentionedEntities > 0 ? round(100.0 * $totalGroundedEntities / $totalMentionedEntities, 2) : 100.0;
 830        $efr = $totalTest > 0 ? round(100.0 * $totalFabricatedEntities / $totalTest, 2) : 0.0;
 831
 832        $meanTotal = count($timings['total']) > 0 ? array_sum($timings['total']) / count($timings['total']) : 0.0;
 833        $meanSql   = count($timings['sql']) > 0 ? array_sum($timings['sql']) / count($timings['sql']) : 0.0;
 834        $meanIntent = count($timings['intent']) > 0 ? array_sum($timings['intent']) / count($timings['intent']) : 0.0;
 835        $meanNlg   = count($timings['nlg']) > 0 ? array_sum($timings['nlg']) / count($timings['nlg']) : 0.0;
 836
 837        return [
 838            'meta' => [
 839                'framework'  => 'CodeIgniter 4.7.4',
 840                'database'   => 'MySQL 8.0 Spatial',
 841                'mode'       => $mode,
 842                'timestamp'  => date('c'),
 843                'total_test' => $totalTest,
 844            ],
 845            'layer_a_semantic_csir' => [
 846                'exact_csir_match_rate'         => $exactCsirAcc,
 847                'exact_csir_count'              => "{$exactCsirMatches}/{$totalTest}",
 848                'execution_envelope_match_rate' => $envelopeAcc,
 849                'execution_envelope_count'      => "{$executionEnvelopeMatches}/{$totalTest}",
 850                'semantic_subdimension_accuracy'    => $calcSubDim(self::SEMANTIC_FIELDS),
 851                'spatial_subdimension_accuracy'     => $calcSubDim(self::SPATIAL_FIELDS),
 852                'operational_subdimension_accuracy' => $calcSubDim(self::OPERATIONAL_FIELDS),
 853                'control_subdimension_accuracy'     => $calcSubDim(self::CONTROL_FIELDS),
 854                'field_accuracies'                  => $fieldAccuracies,
 855            ],
 856            'layer_b_deterministic_validation' => [
 857                'validation_decision_accuracy' => $valDecisionAcc,
 858                'validation_matches_count'     => "{$validationMatches}/{$totalTest}",
 859                'honest_rejection_rate'        => $hrr,
 860                'honest_rejection_count'       => "{$honestRejectionCount}/{$totalOutOfScopeCases}",
 861            ],
 862            'layer_c_spatial_execution' => [
 863                'pure_spatial_predicate_correctness'   => $pureSpatialAcc,
 864                'pure_spatial_matches'                => "{$pureSpatialMatches}/{$totalSpatialCases}",
 865                'chitchat_handling_accuracy'          => $chitchatAcc,
 866                'chitchat_matches'                    => "{$chitchatMatches}/{$totalChitchatCases}",
 867                'overall_execution_compliance_rate'   => $spatialPredAcc,
 868                'overall_execution_matches'           => "{$spatialPredicateMatches}/{$totalTest}",
 869                'spatial_predicate_correctness'       => $spatialPredAcc, // retained for backward compatibility
 870            ],
 871            'layer_d_grounded_generation' => [
 872                'claim_grounding_fidelity_cgf' => $cgf,
 873                'supported_claims'             => $totalSupportedClaims,
 874                'verifiable_claims'            => $totalVerifiableClaims,
 875                'entity_grounding_fidelity_egf'=> $egf,
 876                'grounded_entities'            => $totalGroundedEntities,
 877                'mentioned_entities'           => $totalMentionedEntities,
 878                'entity_fabrication_rate'      => $efr,
 879                'total_fabricated_pois'        => $totalFabricatedEntities,
 880            ],
 881            'latencies_ms' => [
 882                'mean_intent_parsing' => round($meanIntent, 2),
 883                'mean_mysql_spatial'  => round($meanSql, 3),
 884                'mean_grounded_nlg'   => round($meanNlg, 2),
 885                'mean_total'          => round($meanTotal, 2),
 886            ],
 887            'cases' => $scenarioResults,
 888        ];
 889    }
 890
 891    /**
 892     * Render ringkasan hasil evaluasi ke konsol CLI.
 893     */
 894    private function renderConsoleReport(array $aggregated, array $scenarioResults): void
 895    {
 896        $la = $aggregated['layer_a_semantic_csir'];
 897        $lb = $aggregated['layer_b_deterministic_validation'];
 898        $lc = $aggregated['layer_c_spatial_execution'];
 899        $ld = $aggregated['layer_d_grounded_generation'];
 900        $lat = $aggregated['latencies_ms'];
 901
 902        CLI::write("\n==================================================================", 'green');
 903        CLI::write("           RINGKASAN HASIL EVALUASI EMPIRIS 4-LAPISAN", 'yellow');
 904        CLI::write("==================================================================", 'green');
 905
 906        CLI::write("1. LAYER A: CSIR SEMANTIC EXTRACTION ACCURACY", 'cyan');
 907        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Exact CSIR Match Rate (Pre-Fallback)     : %6.2f%% (%s skenario)", $la['exact_csir_match_rate'], $la['exact_csir_count']));
 908        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Execution Envelope Alignment (Post-Policy): %6.2f%% (%s skenario)", $la['execution_envelope_match_rate'], $la['execution_envelope_count']));
 909        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Subdimensi 1: Intensi & Entitas          : %6.2f%%", $la['semantic_subdimension_accuracy']));
 910        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Subdimensi 2: Kendala Spasial            : %6.2f%%", $la['spatial_subdimension_accuracy']));
 911        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Subdimensi 3: Kendala Operasional        : %6.2f%%", $la['operational_subdimension_accuracy']));
 912        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Subdimensi 4: Kontrol & Boundary         : %6.2f%%", $la['control_subdimension_accuracy']));
 913
 914        CLI::write("\n   Rincian Akurasi Field-Level CSIR:");
 915        foreach ($la['field_accuracies'] as $field => $stat) {
 916            CLI::write(sprintf("     - %-18s : %6.2f%% (%d/%d kasus)", $field, $stat['accuracy'], $stat['correct'], $stat['applicable']));
 917        }
 918
 919        CLI::write("\n2. LAYER B: DETERMINISTIC VALIDATION & SAFETY (SirValidator)", 'cyan');
 920        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Validation Decision Accuracy    : %6.2f%% (%s skenario)", $lb['validation_decision_accuracy'], $lb['validation_matches_count']));
 921        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Honest Rejection Rate (HRR)     : %6.2f%% (%s out-of-scope)", $lb['honest_rejection_rate'], $lb['honest_rejection_count']));
 922
 923        CLI::write("\n3. LAYER C: SPATIAL QUERY EXECUTION (MySQL 8.0 ST_Distance_Sphere)", 'cyan');
 924        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Pure Spatial Predicate Correctness (N=36): %6.2f%% (%s skenario)", $lc['pure_spatial_predicate_correctness'], $lc['pure_spatial_matches']));
 925        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Conversational Chit-Chat Handling  (N=2) : %6.2f%% (%s skenario)", $lc['chitchat_handling_accuracy'], $lc['chitchat_matches']));
 926        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Overall Scenario Execution Compliance(N=40): %6.2f%% (%s skenario)", $lc['overall_execution_compliance_rate'], $lc['overall_execution_matches']));
 927
 928        CLI::write("\n4. LAYER D: EVIDENCE GROUNDING & ANTI-HALLUCINATION", 'cyan');
 929        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Claim Grounding Fidelity (CGF)  : %6.2f%% (%d/%d klaim terverifikasi)", $ld['claim_grounding_fidelity_cgf'], $ld['supported_claims'], $ld['verifiable_claims']));
 930        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Entity Grounding Fidelity (EGF) : %6.2f%% (%d/%d sebutan POI)", $ld['entity_grounding_fidelity_egf'], $ld['grounded_entities'], $ld['mentioned_entities']));
 931        CLI::write(sprintf("   • Fabricated POI Entities         : %d entitas teramati (Rate: %4.2f%%)", $ld['total_fabricated_pois'], $ld['entity_fabrication_rate']));
 932
 933        CLI::write("------------------------------------------------------------------");
 934        CLI::write("                 PROFIL LATENSI KOMPUTASI (ms)");
 935        CLI::write("------------------------------------------------------------------");
 936        CLI::write(sprintf("• Intent Extraction (LLM -> CSIR)     : %7.2f ms (%5.2f%%)", $lat['mean_intent_parsing'], $lat['mean_total'] > 0 ? ($lat['mean_intent_parsing'] / $lat['mean_total']) * 100 : 0));
 937        CLI::write(sprintf("• MySQL 8.0 Spatial (ST_Distance_Sphere): %7.2f ms (%5.2f%%)", $lat['mean_mysql_spatial'], $lat['mean_total'] > 0 ? ($lat['mean_mysql_spatial'] / $lat['mean_total']) * 100 : 0));
 938        CLI::write(sprintf("• Grounded NLG Synthesis (LLM -> Text): %7.2f ms (%5.2f%%)", $lat['mean_grounded_nlg'], $lat['mean_total'] > 0 ? ($lat['mean_grounded_nlg'] / $lat['mean_total']) * 100 : 0));
 939        CLI::write(sprintf("• TOTAL LATENSI PERCAKAPAN SERVER     : %7.2f ms (~%4.2f detik)", $lat['mean_total'], $lat['mean_total'] / 1000.0));
 940        CLI::write("==================================================================", 'green');
 941
 942        // Tampilkan diagnostik kasus mismatch jika ada
 943        $mismatches = [];
 944        foreach ($scenarioResults as $r) {
 945            if (!$r['exact_csir_match']) {
 946                $mismatches[] = $r;
 947            }
 948        }
 949
 950        if (!empty($mismatches)) {
 951            CLI::write("\n[DIAGNOSTIK KASUS MISMATCH CSIR (PRE-FALLBACK EXTRACTION)]", 'yellow');
 952            foreach ($mismatches as $m) {
 953                CLI::write(sprintf("  • CASE #%02d [%s] - Prompt: \"%s\"", $m['id'], $m['grup'], $m['prompt']), 'red');
 954                foreach ($m['field_matches'] as $fld => $st) {
 955                    if ($st === 'MISMATCH') {
 956                        $expVal = $m['expected'][$fld] ?? null;
 957                        $actVal = $m['predicted_intent_csir'][$fld] ?? null;
 958                        $exp = is_bool($expVal) ? ($expVal ? 'true' : 'false') : ($expVal ?? 'null');
 959                        $act = is_bool($actVal) ? ($actVal ? 'true' : 'false') : ($actVal ?? 'null');
 960                        CLI::write(sprintf("      - Field '%s' MISMATCH: Expected [%s] vs Predicted [%s]", $fld, (string)$exp, (string)$act), 'yellow');
 961                    }
 962                }
 963            }
 964        } else {
 965            CLI::write("\n[DIAGNOSTIK] Seluruh 40 skenario lulus Exact CSIR Match tanpa mismatch semantik!", 'green');
 966        }
 967    }

 969    /**
 970     * Menyusun tabel matriks audit per-kasus (40 skenario) dalam format Markdown.
 971     */
 972    private function generateTraceabilityMatrix(array $scenarioResults): string
 973    {
 974        $md = "# MATRIKS AUDIT KESELARASAN PER-KASUS (40 SKENARIO BENCHMARK)\n\n";
 975        $md .= "Matriks ini mendokumentasikan nilai acuan (*ground truth*), nilai prediksi ekstraksi semantik (*Raw CSIR*),\n";
 976        $md .= "resolusi batas kebijakan spasial (*Execution Envelope*), perbandingan atribut, dan status kelulusan tiap skenario.\n\n";
 977        $md .= "| ID | Grup Skenario | Prompt Pengguna | Tipe Skenario | Expected (Acuan) | Extracted CSIR | Envelope Eksekusi | Status CSIR | Predikat Spasial | Catatan Deviasi / Kebijakan |\n";
 978        $md .= "|:---:|---|---|:---:|---|---|---|:---:|:---:|---|\n";
 979
 980        foreach ($scenarioResults as $r) {
 981            $id = $r['id'];
 982            $grup = $r['grup'];
 983            $prompt = str_replace('|', '/', $r['prompt']);
 984            $type = $r['scenario_type'];
 985            
 986            // Expected summary
 987            $exp = $r['expected'];
 988            $expSum = sprintf("intent: %s, cat: %s, op: %s, ref: %s", $exp['intent'] ?? '-', $exp['category'] ?? 'null', $exp['spatial_operator'] ?? '-', $exp['reference_type'] ?? '-');
 989            if ($exp['is_out_of_scope'] ?? false) $expSum .= " (OOS)";
 990
 991            // Pred CSIR summary
 992            $act = $r['predicted_intent_csir'];
 993            $actSum = sprintf("intent: %s, cat: %s, op: %s, ref: %s", $act['intent'] ?? '-', $act['category'] ?? 'null', $act['spatial_operator'] ?? '-', $act['reference_type'] ?? '-');
 994
 995            // Envelope summary
 996            $env = $r['resolved_execution_envelope'];
 997            $envSum = sprintf("ref: %s, lat: %s, lng: %s", $env['reference_type'] ?? '-', $env['latitude'] ?? 'null', $env['longitude'] ?? 'null');
 998
 999            $csirStatus = $r['exact_csir_match'] ? '✅ EXACT' : '⚠️ MISMATCH';
1000            $spatStatus = $r['spatial_predicate_match'] ? '✅ PASS' : '❌ FAIL';
1001
1002            // Catatan
1003            $notes = [];
1004            foreach ($r['field_matches'] as $fld => $st) {
1005                if ($st === 'MISMATCH') {
1006                    $notes[] = sprintf("%s: exp=[%s] vs act=[%s]", $fld, $exp[$fld] ?? 'null', $act[$fld] ?? 'null');
1007                }
1008            }
1009            if (!empty($r['fallback_applied'])) {
1010                $notes[] = "Fallback diterapkan (Domain Boundary Notice: Pusat Padang)";
1011            }
1012            $noteStr = empty($notes) ? "Sempurna (100% Cocok)" : implode('; ', $notes);
1013            $noteStr = str_replace('|', '/', $noteStr);
1014
1015            $md .= sprintf("| **%02d** | %s | *\"%s\"* | `%s` | `%s` | `%s` | `%s` | %s | %s | %s |\n",
1016                $id, $grup, $prompt, $type, $expSum, $actSum, $envSum, $csirStatus, $spatStatus, $noteStr
1017            );
1018        }
1019
1020        return $md;
1021    }
1022}

 19    /**

 21     */
 22    public function testSchemaSanitization()
 23    {
 24        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
 25            targetName: '<script>alert("hack")</script>Pantai Padang',
 26            keyword: '<b>pasir putih</b>'
 27        );
 28
 29        $res = $this->validator->validate($sir);
 30
 31        $this->assertTrue($res['isValid']);

 38     */
 39    public function testNegativeRadiusMustBeRejectedWithoutAbs()
 40    {
 41        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
 42            spatialOperator: 'within_radius',
 43            radius: -5.0
 44        );
 45
 46        $res = $this->validator->validate($sir);

102        $this->assertSame('clarify_user', $sir->executionPolicy);
103        $this->assertNotEmpty($sir->validationErrors);
104        $this->assertStringContainsString('memerlukan spesifikasi radius pencarian', $sir->validationErrors[0]);
105    }
106
107    /**
108     * Uji Dimensi 4: Koordinat di luar batas bola bumi WGS84 harus ditolak.
109     */
110    public function testCoordinateBounds()
111    {
112        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
113            latitude: 120.0, // Invalid latitude (> 90)
114            longitude: 100.35
115        );
116
117        $res = $this->validator->validate($sir);
118
119        $this->assertFalse($res['isValid']);
120        $this->assertStringContainsString('Koordinat latitude di luar batas WGS84', $sir->validationErrors[0]);
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * Uji Dimensi 5: Harmonisasi preferensi anggaran (is_free = true dan max_price > 0 bukan kontradiksi).
125     * Secara relasional {harga = 0} ⊆ {harga <= P}, sehingga kueri harus VALID.
126     */
127    public function testInclusiveBudgetConstraintIsValid()
128    {
129        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
130            isFree: true,
131            maxPrice: 25000
132        );
133
134        $res = $this->validator->validate($sir);
135
136        $this->assertTrue($res['isValid']);
137        $this->assertEmpty($res['errors']);
138        $this->assertSame('execute_sql', $res['executionPolicy']);
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * Uji Dimensi 5: Harga maksimum negatif harus ditolak secara tegas.
143     */
144    public function testNegativePriceMustFail()
145    {
146        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
147            maxPrice: -5000
148        );
149
150        $res = $this->validator->validate($sir);
151
152        $this->assertFalse($res['isValid']);
153        $this->assertStringContainsString('tidak boleh bernilai negatif', $sir->validationErrors[0]);
154    }
155
156    /**
157     * Uji Dimensi 6: Permintaan luar lingkup (Out-of-Scope) harus ditolak secara jujur.
158     */
159    public function testOutOfScopeDetection()
160    {
161        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
162            rawQuery: 'Saya mau main ski salju dan kasino di Padang'
163        );
164
165        $res = $this->validator->validate($sir);
166
167        $this->assertFalse($res['isValid']);
168        $this->assertTrue($sir->isOutOfScope);
169        $this->assertSame('out_of_scope', $sir->validationStatus);
170        $this->assertSame('reject_out_of_scope', $sir->executionPolicy);
171    }
172
173    /**
174     * Uji Formal Multi-Turn Semantic State Merging: CSIR_{t+1} = Merge(CSIR_t, \Delta CSIR_{t+1})
175     */
176    public function testMultiTurnSemanticStateMerging()
177    {
178        // Turn 1: Inisiasi spasial Pantai Padang
179        $csir1 = new SpatialIntent(
180            category: 'Pantai',
181            referenceType: 'gps',
182            latitude: -0.958742,
183            longitude: 100.354128,
184            spatialOperator: 'nearest',
185            rawQuery: 'Cari pantai dekat saya'
186        );
187        $this->validator->validate($csir1);
188
189        // Turn 2: Delta batasan harga (ujaran eliptik tanpa menyebut ulang 'pantai' atau GPS)
190        $delta2 = new SpatialIntent(
191            maxPrice: 15000,
192            rawQuery: 'Yang tiketnya di bawah 15 ribu'
193        );
194        $this->validator->validate($delta2);
195
196        // State transition: CSIR_2 = Merge(CSIR_1, Delta_2)
197        $csir2 = $csir1->mergeWith($delta2);
198
199        $this->assertSame('Pantai', $csir2->category);
200        $this->assertSame('gps', $csir2->referenceType);
201        $this->assertSame(-0.958742, $csir2->latitude);
202        $this->assertSame('nearest', $csir2->spatialOperator);
203        $this->assertSame(15000, $csir2->maxPrice);
204
205        // Turn 3: Delta batasan jam operasional
206        $delta3 = new SpatialIntent(
207            openNow: true,
208            rawQuery: 'Yang buka sekarang'
209        );
210        $this->validator->validate($delta3);
211
212        // State transition: CSIR_3 = Merge(CSIR_2, Delta_3)
213        $csir3 = $csir2->mergeWith($delta3);
214
215        $this->assertSame('Pantai', $csir3->category);
216        $this->assertSame(-0.958742, $csir3->latitude);
217        $this->assertSame(15000, $csir3->maxPrice);
218        $this->assertTrue($csir3->openNow);
219    }
220}

  1<?php
  2
  3namespace Tests\Unit;
  4
  5use App\Services\SpatialIntent\SpatialIntent;
  6use App\Services\SpatialIntent\SpatialQueryCompiler;
  7use CodeIgniter\Test\CIUnitTestCase;
  8
  9class SpatialQueryCompilerTest extends CIUnitTestCase
 10{
 11    protected SpatialQueryCompiler $compiler;
 12
 13    protected function setUp(): void
 14    {
 15        parent::setUp();
 16        $this->compiler = new SpatialQueryCompiler();
 17    }
 18
 19    /**
 20     * Safety Invariant: Kueri tidak valid dilarang dieksekusi!
 21     */
 22    public function testInvalidSirIsNotExecutable()
 23    {
 24        $sir = new SpatialIntent(isValid: false);
 25        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir);
 26
 27        $this->assertFalse($res['isExecutable']);
 28        $this->assertSame('', $res['sql']);
 29        $this->assertEmpty($res['params']);
 30    }
 31
 32    /**
 33     * Uji kompilasi kueri terdekat dengan ST_Distance_Sphere pada MySQL 8.0.
 34     */
 35    public function testNearestSpatialQueryCompilation()
 36    {
 37        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
 38            category: 'Pantai',
 39            spatialOperator: 'nearest',
 40            latitude: -0.9489,
 41            longitude: 100.3572,
 42            isValid: true
 43        );
 44
 45        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir, 5);
 46
 47        $this->assertTrue($res['isExecutable']);
 48        $this->assertStringContainsString('ST_Distance_Sphere', $res['sql']);
 49        $this->assertStringContainsString('kategori.nama = ?', $res['sql']);
 50        $this->assertStringContainsString('ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere', $res['sql']);
 51        $this->assertContains('Pantai', $res['params']);
 52        $this->assertContains(5, $res['params']);
 53    }
 54
 55    /**
 56     * Uji kompilasi kueri radius dengan batas ST_Distance_Sphere.
 57     */
 58    public function testWithinRadiusSpatialQueryCompilation()
 59    {
 60        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
 61            spatialOperator: 'within_radius',
 62            latitude: -0.9489,
 63            longitude: 100.3572,
 64            radius: 10.0,
 65            isValid: true
 66        );
 67
 68        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir, 10);
 69
 70        $this->assertTrue($res['isExecutable']);
 71        $this->assertStringContainsString('(ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(wisata.lng, wisata.lat), POINT(?, ?)) / 1000.0) <= ?', $res['sql']);
 72        $this->assertContains(10.0, $res['params']);
 73    }
 74
 75    /**
 76     * Security Test: Injeksi SQL berbahaya via kata kunci (' OR 1=1 --).
 77     * Memastikan string injeksi selalu di-bind sebagai nilai parameter literal (PDO binding),
 78     * tidak pernah memodifikasi struktur pohon sintaksis kueri SQL.
 79     */
 80    public function testSqlInjectionAttemptIsParameterizedAsLiteral()
 81    {
 82        $maliciousPayload = "' OR 1=1 --";
 83        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
 84            keyword: $maliciousPayload,
 85            isValid: true
 86        );
 87
 88        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir);
 89
 90        $this->assertTrue($res['isExecutable']);
 91        $this->assertStringNotContainsString("' OR 1=1 --", $res['sql']);
 92        $this->assertStringContainsString('wisata.nama LIKE ?', $res['sql']);
 93        $this->assertContains('%' . $maliciousPayload . '%', $res['params']);
 94    }
 95
 96    /**
 97     * Security Test 2: Injeksi DDL berbahaya (DROP TABLE wisata;).
 98     * Memastikan string DDL diperlakukan sebagai literal pencarian teks, bukan pernyataan SQL independen.
 99     */
100    public function testArbitraryDdlInjectionIsParameterized()
101    {
102        $maliciousDdl = "'; DROP TABLE wisata; --";
103        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
104            targetName: $maliciousDdl,
105            isValid: true
106        );
107
108        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir);
109
110        $this->assertTrue($res['isExecutable']);
111        $this->assertStringNotContainsString("DROP TABLE", $res['sql']);
112        $this->assertContains('%' . $maliciousDdl . '%', $res['params']);
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * Security Test 3: Kueri out-of-scope harus menggagalkan kompilasi secara deterministik.
117     */
118    public function testOutOfScopeSirIsRejectedByCompiler()
119    {
120        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
121            isValid: false,
122            isOutOfScope: true
123        );
124
125        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir);
126
127        $this->assertFalse($res['isExecutable']);
128        $this->assertSame('', $res['sql']);
129        $this->assertEmpty($res['params']);
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * Uji kompilasi tiket murni gratis (Zero-Cost Invariant: WHERE harga_tiket = 0).
134     */
135    public function testStrictFreeBudgetCompilation()
136    {
137        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
138            isFree: true,
139            maxPrice: null,
140            isValid: true
141        );
142
143        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir);
144
145        $this->assertTrue($res['isExecutable']);
146        $this->assertStringContainsString('wisata.harga_tiket = 0', $res['sql']);
147    }
148
149    /**
150     * Uji kompilasi anggaran inklusif (is_free = true DAN max_price > 0).
151     * Harus mengizinkan tiket <= max_price dan memprioritaskan yang gratis (Rp 0).
152     */
153    public function testInclusiveBudgetCompilation()
154    {
155        $sir = new SpatialIntent(
156            isFree: true,
157            maxPrice: 15000,
158            isValid: true
159        );
160
161        $res = $this->compiler->compile($sir);
162
163        $this->assertTrue($res['isExecutable']);
164        $this->assertStringContainsString('wisata.harga_tiket <= ?', $res['sql']);
165        $this->assertStringContainsString('(wisata.harga_tiket = 0) DESC', $res['sql']);
166        $this->assertContains(15000, $res['params']);
167    }
168}
